description.INCIDENT_DETAIL_CN: 中秋節假期加強列車服務

2026-09-21T18:06:00.CONTENT_EN:
Transport Department has received notification from MTR Corporation Limited that MTR Corporation Limited will enhance the train service during the Mid-Autumn Festival and over the following weekend.

Mid-Autumn Festival (25 September)
- Enhanced train service from 3pm: Local Lines (except Airport Express and Disneyland Resort Line)
- Extended service hours for around 1.5 hours: Local Lines (except Airport Express, Disneyland Resort Line, and cross-boundary journeys on the East Rail Line to or from Lo Wu or Lok Ma Chau stations), Light Rail
- Extended service hours: MTR Bus routes 506, K51 and K54A

Mid-Autumn Festival weekend (26 to 27 September)
- More frequent train trips on the East Rail Line at different periods

Crowd management measures may be implemented in stations where necessary. Members of the public can refer to the information on the MTR Corporation Limited's website or mobile application.

description.INCIDENT_DETAIL_EN: Diagonal crossing at On Ming Street/On Muk Street in Sha Tin commissioned
description.INCIDENT_DETAIL_CN: 沙田安明街／安睦街對角行人過路處啓用

2026-09-22T11:27:00.CONTENT_EN:
Diagonal crossing at On Ming Street/On Muk Street in Sha Tin commissioned
A diagonal crossing at the junction of On Ming Street and On Muk Street in Sha Tin has been commissioned on 22 September 2026 to bring convenience to pedestrians in the district in walking across the junction diagonally, thereby shortening walking distance and saving time. This delivers on the objective of optimising crossing and walking environments set out in the Transport Strategy Blueprint.
2026-09-22T11:27:00.CONTENT_CN:
沙田安明街／安睦街對角行人過路處啓用
沙田安明街與安睦街交界路口的對角行人過路處已於2026年9月22日啓用，便利區內行人以較短距離橫過至對角位置，節省步行時間，落實《運輸策略藍圖》優化過路及步行環境的目標。
